Chapter 416: Chapter 21 The Gift of the Supreme Being (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

“Hahahaha, you little fellow, don’t be nervous. It’s not an uncommon thing for your spirit will to have experienced more years than your physical soul. Many attributed talents can achieve this, such as ‘Eternal Dream,’ ‘Time Chamber,’ and so on.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being shook his head with a smile.

As a Supreme Being, one could go against the flow of the River of Time, naturally being able to slow the passage of time.

In the blink of an eye on the outside, one could experience millions of years.

Or, while millions of years pass by on the outside, only a moment goes by for oneself.

...

Moreover, many attributed abilities can also do this, mostly related to time.

“Eternal Dream… Time Chamber…”

Lin Yuan secretly breathed a sigh of relief. Although he didn’t know the specifics, since the Supreme Being said so, it must be related to the flow of time.

Indeed.

For a Supreme Being, controlling time isn’t a difficult task; even the dead can be resurrected, so what is accelerating or slowing the passage of time?

Of course, when it comes to the speed of time, only Supreme Beings or those who have mastered the complete Rule of Time can do it, belonging to the most top-tier abilities and opportunities.

“Judging by the passage of years of your spirit will, you should be about two thousand years old.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan and said.

“Supreme Being…”

Lin Yuan heard this and didn’t speak.

“Hahahaha, are you now thinking that your name as a genius is going to be gone?” teased Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“Indeed…”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“You don’t need to think like that,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said, “If you live long enough, you can step into the Eighth Layer. How could our Human Alliance’s Eighth Layer only consist of so little?”

“Besides, the Goddess of Wisdom said you are the founder of an Evolution Path, and the path you have opened has tremendous potential.”

“Under the condition of continuously pioneering Evolution Paths, merely having a spirit will age of two thousand years and achieving this much, in human civilization history, your talent is enough to rank in the top twenty or top ten.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a smile.

If Lin Yuan’s spirit will age were the same as his physical Primordial Spirit, only a little over thirty years old, he would have doubted if there was some other background to Lin Yuan.

A little over thirty years old, stepping into the Eighth Layer, pioneering an Evolution Path with tremendous potential—it just couldn’t be done.

Even the Supreme Being would find it absurd.

“The top twenty or top ten in human civilization history…”

Lin Yuan blinked his eyes.

Such an evaluation was terrifyingly high. This was the history of human civilization, the Starry Sea Era that spanned over two million years; how many prodigies and monsters had human civilization produced?

Even including the nine Supreme Beings, being able to rank in the top twenty or top ten meant he was at the very top just below the Supreme Beings, right?

…

Hearing Xia Qin Supreme Being’s evaluation of himself, Lin Yuan couldn’t help feeling a bit smug, but he quickly recovered.

No matter how strong the talent, if it could not be converted into strength, it was meaningless.

In the two million years of the Starry Sea Era, many Evolvers had the potential to become Supreme Beings, but in the end, human civilization only had nine Supreme Beings.

“Having an attributed talent like ‘Eternal Dream’ can indeed give a great advantage in the early stages of cultivation, but that’s about it. At the Seventh or Eighth Rank, such abilities are no longer so critical,” Xia Qin Supreme Being stated.

So-called ‘Eternal Dream’ is experiencing thousands of years within a dream, a feat easily achievable by a Supreme Being.

Even if Lin Yuan used abilities like ‘Eternal Dream,’ just taking a little over two thousand years to reach his current point still couldn’t conceal his heaven-defying talent.

That was why Xia Qin Supreme Being rated Lin Yuan among the top twenty or top ten in the entire history of human civilization.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan said softly.

In fact, the traveling ability of the Door to the Myriad Realms was far from as simple as ‘Eternal Dream.’

Traversing to a world, absorbing the essence of that world’s cultivation system, and perceiving the fluctuations of many rules across different dimensions and planes.

This was far more precious than the speed of time.

Xia Qin Supreme Being had only noticed that something was off with the passage of Lin Yuan’s spirit will time but had yet to discover the existence of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

“With your talent and aptitude, there shouldn’t be too big of an obstacle in the practice at the Eighth Layer level, but when it comes to the final Fusion Rules, you have to think carefully,” said Xia Qin Supreme Being.

“The Fusion Rules here are not ordinary fusion among rules, but a fusion between pillar rules and other rules.”

“`

“You must carefully consider which rules to integrate with the pillar rules,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being advised.

“Thank you for your guidance, Supreme Being,”

Lin Yuan nodded. The so-called pillar rules referred to the Space Rules, Rule of Time, Rules of Life, and so on.

“Now that you have stepped into the Eighth Layer, I presume you are about to head to the Fringe Starfield to preside for five hundred years?” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan.

“Yes,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“But I haven’t chosen which Star Domain yet,”

Lin Yuan said.

“The Fringe Starfield is fraught with danger; therefore, I will give you a treasure,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

“Don’t refuse. Do you think you are strong? Have the Doppelganger Skill? Or that with our intervention in resurrection, you will not die?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan and shook his head.

“The Doppelganger Skill is not foolproof, and the method of resurrection does not bring back everything,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being continued, “For instance, with memory contamination, no matter how many Avatars you have, you will have to die. After resurrection, as long as the memory remains, you will still have to die.”

“Memory contamination…”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn. Such methods, with more restrictive conditions than Curse-Killing Skill, would be difficult for even a Tenth Rank being to apply to him, given his current strength.

“I will bestow upon you a treasure, called the ‘Soul-Settling Pearl’; even if a Supreme Being attempts memory contamination on you or uses other means, you will be able to persist for an instant,”

“At that moment, detonate yourself immediately and wait for me to resurrect you,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being spoke calmly.

“Can it withstand a Supreme Being for an instant?”

Lin Yuan was shocked. What existence were Supreme Beings? Their attacks were unpredictable and profound. For example, if an Alien Strong One wanted to kill Lin Yuan before he met Xia Qin Supreme Being, it would not be too difficult.

It could even be a permanent kill, beyond the scope of resurrection.

But Supreme Beings have their pride. Presently, to the outside world, Lin Yuan was just an Eighth Layer being under a hundred years old, not warranting a Supreme Being’s intervention.

If it were revealed that Lin Yuan was not only an Eighth Layer being under a hundred years old but also the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the situation might change.

“Remember,”

“Once the ‘Soul-Settling Pearl’ is activated passively, you must not hesitate to choose self-detonation. Do not delay,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said gravely.

As long as Lin Yuan had not been subjected to memory contamination or the like, Xia Qin Supreme Being would be able to resurrect him, leaving the essentials unharmed.

But once memory contaminated, just like the Heart Demon Tribulation, even a Supreme Being could not remove all, meaning even after resurrection, death would still ensue.

“Understood,”

Lin Yuan said in a deep voice.

What Xia Qin Supreme Being was considering were the extreme situations Lin Yuan might face. Under normal circumstances, a Supreme Being would not intervene.

If an Alien Supreme Being took action to erase a human prodigy, then the Supreme Beings of human civilization would also intervene, erasing the geniuses of the Different Species.

In that case, no one would dare venture out.

Unless the Alien Supreme Being saw in Lin Yuan the hope of becoming a Supreme Being.

Otherwise, it would not even bother to pay attention.

And while there have been several Eighth Layer Evolvers under a hundred years old throughout the history of human civilization, very few ultimately touched the realm of Supreme Beings.

Xia Qin Supreme Being was aware that Lin Yuan was the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, and as the founder, having no path laid out before him yet still reaching this point, there certainly was potential for him to become a Supreme Being.

But Xia Qin Supreme Being knew what the Alien Supreme Beings did not.

Within the whole Human Civilization, only three goddesses and nine Supreme Beings knew that Lin Yuan was the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“The Soul-Settling Pearl will be delivered to you as soon as possible,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being gestured dismissively and proceeded to send Lin Yuan away from the Virtual World.

After Lin Yuan had vanished,

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s smile began to fade.

“I hope… you grow up successfully,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being looked towards the last spot where Lin Yuan had stood, with a glimmer of anticipation in his eyes.
